settings.note: Fixes pixelated smoke in game and bad vignette effect (gradient made of bars) on menus visible if upscaling at 200% or above
Fixes bug present on some sections (e.g. "Holar Tower, Iceland") consisting on the appearance of smoke (not present on PS3) when running and disappearing when walking.
To be used in combination with "Unlock FPS" patch which will allow the game to run at 60 FPS.

patches.name: Unlock FPS
patches.note: Can cause issues with physics in-game. Not allowed in online play.
